title: 3 Years Ago, Crunchyroll’s Critically Acclaimed Action Anime Ended & Fans Still Need a Sequel
content:
There’s no doubt Crunchyroll is the biggest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe. This is all the more reason that most of the major anime land on the platform. Bungo Stray Dogs is one such beloved series that fans from several regions across the globe can stream on the platform. The anime is based on a critically acclaimed manga written by Kafka Asagiri and illustrated by Sango Harukawa. Although the anime was decently popular after its debut, it eventually gained recognition across the globe as the series released more seasons. Over the years, the series has released five seasons and even a feature-length film, but there haven’t been any updates since 2023.

The series is commemorating its 10th anniversary this year , and it has already shared several exciting updates for fans. However, none of the new projects include anything related to the main story’s continuation in the anime. The future looks bleak after the manga’s unexpected hiatus earlier this year. The latest season was by far the most shocking and intense part of the story, but things will only continue to go downhill for the Armed Detective Agency. Not to mention that manga readers already know that the sixth season will be even more exciting.

Bungo Stray Dogs Season 6 Will Take Longer Than Expected

While it may look like three years is more than enough time for any animation studio to work on a new season, the problem lies with the lack of material. When the anime was airing Season 5, it had already caught up with the manga, meaning fans would’ve had to wait longer than expected . It also doesn’t help that it’s a monthly manga, so there’s a slower trickle of content compared to the other anime series that release new seasons every couple of years. However, another major problem, and quite possibly the biggest one, is that the manga is currently on indefinite hiatus. In March this year, the manga ended its first part on a major cliffhanger, which completely shocked fans. There had been no previous mention of a manga having multiple parts or even a hiatus.

Even after several months, Bungo Stray Dogs hasn’t shared any updates on its return. As long as the manga doesn’t return with its second part, it’s unlikely that the anime will return anytime soon. However, although fans might have to wait longer than expected, there’s no doubt that a sequel season will eventually be released. The final episode of Season 5 already confirmed the anime will continue, although further details haven’t been shared yet. Additionally, fans also witnessed a glimpse at what to expect in Season 6 when Atsushi and Akutagawa teamed up again to fight a new enemy. While the Decay of Angels have been defeated, the Armed Detective Agency and Port Mafia still have to face off against numerous enemies to keep Yokohama safe.

What’s New With Bungo Stray Dogs ?

While the main story’s future is uncertain, the spin-off series, Bungo Stray Dogs Wan , returned with a new season in July this year as part of the Summer 2026 lineup. The anime premiered in 2021, and it took five years to release a sequel. It’s an official spin-off story written and illustrated by Neco Kanai, who is also behind several anthologies of Bungo Stray Dogs . The series uses adorable chibi-style versions of the beloved characters and follows their everyday lives. Although the visuals are significantly more light-hearted compared to the original, it doesn’t skip over the true spirit of the main story. There are also anniversary projects since the franchise has stayed relevant over the years even without a new season.

The anime held major exhibitions in Yokohama and Tokyo this year, and it will move to Osaka next month. A new project was also revealed earlier this year where the manga artist will share 35 new original visuals while the manga is on hiatus. The manga has released 28 volumes so far, out of which 27 have already been published in English. The English release date of Volume 28 hasn’t been revealed yet. Since the manga is on hiatus, there won’t be another new volume for the time being. In the meantime, you can also catch up with all anime seasons, spin-offs, and the movie on Crunchyroll.

Are you already caught up with the manga? Which scene are you looking forward to seeing in Season 6? Let us know in the comments.

title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Game Streams Opening Cinematic
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment America began streaming a 16-minute opening cinematic trailer for Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve , the newest game in its Ace Combat modern air combat franchise , on Thursday.

The game will launch on October 2 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam . Players will also receive Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War as a pre-order bonus for the game. The game's Deluxe Edition will launch on September 29.

The main online multiplayer modes include Co-Op Assault, in which two teams of four players compete for high scores in missions, and Co-Op Warfare, in which two teams of four play against each other and NPCs.

IGN streamed the first three episodes of Ace Combat Hour Zero , a live-action prequel series for the game, on its website and YouTube channel on September 15, 17, and 23. It will stream the fourth episode on September 29. Each episode is 6-11 minutes long.

The prequel stars Josh Holloway ( Lost ) as a pilot, Brandon Routh ( Superman Returns ) as a doctor, and Tamlyn Tomita ( Cobra Kai ) as a news anchor.

IGN describes the prequel's story:

In the series, three strangers survive the opening days of the Republic of Sotoa's invasion of the Federation of Central Usea. Josh Holloway stars as a pilot with nowhere to land, Brandon Routh as a doctor who saved his enemy, and Tamlyn Tomita as a news anchor silenced for telling the truth.

Bandai Namco Entertainment released the Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown game in January 2019 for PlayStation 4 (with PlayStation VR support) and Xbox One, and in February 2019 for PC via Steam . The game was originally slated for 2017, but was delayed to 2018 before the latest delay to 2019. The game is also available to play on Xbox Series X|S. Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown Deluxe Edition launched digitally exclusively for Switch in July 2024.

Namco released the first Ace Combat game in 1992.

title: New Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, 2027 Premiere
content:
The official YouTube channel for the Code Geass franchise began streaming on Saturday a teaser trailer for Code Geass Star Chaser Aspal ( Code Geass Hoshi Oi no Aspal ), the new anime in the franchise , and it reveals the 2027 premiere:

An official crossover manga between Code Geass and Gundam Wing , titled Shin Kidō Senki Gundam W x Code Geass - Hangyaku no Lelouch - Minuet Zero ( Mobile Suit Gundam Wing x Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Minuet Zero), on Kadokawa 's KadoComi platform launched on July 10. Kōjirō Taniguchi from Sunrise is credited with the scenario.

The Code Geass 20th anniversary project also includes the previously announced new musical stage play Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - Seido ni Jyunzuru Kishi 2 ( Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion - A Knight who Follows His Beliefs 2), which will run in Osaka from January 23-25 and in Tokyo from January 29-February 1. A 20th Anniversary Exhibition will also open in Tokyo in September 2026, and in Osaka in November 2026.

The Code Geass franchise announced in December 2024 that it has several "new works in production."

The original Code Geass television series premiered in 2006, followed by a sequel series in 2008. The series has inspired various manga and original video anime, including the five-part Code Geass: Akito the Exiled spinoff, which played in limited theatrical screenings from 2012 to 2016 before its home video release.

The first film in the series' compilation recap trilogy, Code Geass - Hangyaku no Lelouch - Kōdō (lit.: The Awakening Path, official English subtitle: Initiation), opened in Japan in October 2017. The second film, Code Geass - Hangyaku no Lelouch - Handō (lit.: The Rebellion Path, official English subtitle: Transgression), opened in Japan in February 2018. The third film, Code Geass - Hangyaku no Lelouch - Ōdō (lit.: The Imperial Path, official English subtitle: Glorification), opened in May 2018. Funimation released the trilogy on Blu-ray Disc.

Code Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection opened in February 2019 in 120 theaters in Japan. Funimation screened the film in North America in May 2019. Producer Kōjirō Taniguchi said in April 2019 that the film is "phase 1" of a 10-year plan for new content in the Code Geass franchise .

Code Geass : Rozé of the Recapture played in four parts in theaters in Japan from May to August 2024. It also streamed on Disney+ as 12 weekly episodes.

title: 'Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 4th Season' Part 2 Announced for Summer 2027, 'Clayman Revenge' Spin-off Gets TV Anime for Spring 2027
content:
• The 24th and final episode of the Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 4th Season ( That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Season 4 ) television anime announced on Friday that its second part will premiere in July 2027.

The official website simultaneously announced a television anime adaptation of Wataru Kajika 's spin-off manga Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken: Clayman Revenge ( That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Clayman's Revenge ), revealing the main staff, teaser visual (pictured right), and a special collaboration video containing both announcements. The new spinoff anime will premiere in April 2027.

Synopsis (Clayman Revenge) After that final scream rang out during the Walpurgis Festival, the dreams of the Marionette Master were thought to be done for good. But either through the vagaries of fate or the decision of the world at large, Clayman's theater has opened up for one more act. (Source: Kodansha)

Staff (Clayman Revenge) Director: Kentarou Sugimoto ( Blue Lock episode director) Series Composition: Yuuji Haibara ( Tensura Nikki: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken director) Character Design: Asumi Hashimoto ( Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei 3rd Season sub character design), Hideki Sakai ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken 2nd Season chief animation director) Animation Production: 8bit

Voice cast from the main television anime will reprise their roles in the spin-off.

Shounen Sirius began serializing spin-off manga in April 2022. The ninth volume went on sale on August 7. Kodansha is releasing the English translation of the spin-off manga through K Manga.

The fourth anime season adapting Taiki Kawakami 's manga adaptation of Fuse and Mitz Vah 's isekai fantasy light novel began airing on April 3. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with multiple subtitles and dubs.

Produced by animation studio 8bit, the first season aired in 24 episodes in Fall 2018. The second season aired in split cours in Winter 2021 and Summer 2021. The third season aired in 24 episodes in Spring 2024.

The first spinoff anime, Tensura Nikki: Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ( The Slime Diaries: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ), aired in Spring 2021. Crunchyroll and Funimation streamed the anime series with English subtitles.

Shounen Sirius began serializing Kawakami's manga adaptation in March 2015. The 32nd volume was released on June 9, with the 33th volume scheduled to go on sale on October 8.

Fuse began writing the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from February 2013 to October 2016. Micro Magazine acquired the novel and began publishing it under their GC Novels imprint in May 2014, featuring illustrations by Mitz Vah. The 23rd and final volume was shipped in November 2025.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in October 2016. The 29th volume was released on March 31, with the 30th volume scheduled to go on sale on October 27.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in April 2017. The 22nd volume went on sale on February 10.

title: Sweet Shop Comics Platform Hosts Glacier Bay Books Manga Titles
content:
• Pandora

• Dream Another Dream

• Mothers

• Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice

• Red Riding Hood's Wolf Apprentice II: Final Testament to the Moon

• Rabbit Game

• Children of Mu-Town

• Ripples

The company confirmed that more titles are on the way to Sweet Shop.

The publisher revealed in April that the following titles are recently finished or are about to finish printing: Baku Chan , Box Garden Beetle , The Cursed Body , and Star Clock Liddell .

Glacier Bay Books had announced in February that Star Fruit Books was transferring its publishing line and inventory to Glacier Bay Books . This followed the death of Star Fruit Books ' founder Matt Haasch in September 2025. In April, Glacier Bay Books stated that it had received most of Star Fruit Books ' inventory, and would be processing the inventory and starting to prepare shipments for orders it is able to fulfill with the existing inventory. Glacier Bay Books plans to add excess stock for sale through its own website, after processing and fulfilling Star Fruit Books ' existing orders.

KiraKira Media Inc.'s digital manga service Omoi (formerly Azuki ) added manga from Glacier Bay Books and Star Fruit Books in 2022.

title: Hell Mode Anime Gets 3rd Season for 'S-Rank Dungeon Conquest Arc'
content:
The official website for the television anime of writer Hamuo and illustrator Mo 's Hell Mode - The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing ( Hell Mode - Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musō Suru ) light novel series announced on Saturday that the anime is getting a third season for the "S-Kyū Dungeon Kо̄ryaku-hen" ("S-Rank Dungeon Conquest Arc"). The website unveiled a visual:

The second season ended on Friday (effectively, Saturday).

Masato Tamagawa ( Saint Seiya: Saintia Shō , The Genius Prince's Guide to Raising a Nation Out of Debt , The Great Cleric ) returned to direct the new season at Yokohama Animation Lab . Daishiro Tanimura ( Magical Destroyers ) was also back in charge of the series scripts. Kei Tsushima ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These ) designed the characters again. Misaki Tsuchida , Junko Nakajima , Reiko Abe , Moyu Kanazaki , Kaho Sawada , Kanade Sakuma , BeauDamian , and Tsugumi Tanaka all composed the music again, alongside Shūichirō Fukuhiro , Mayo Kurihara , and Shin Miki .

The series debuted on the Tokyo MX channel on July 3 at 25:00 (effectively, July 4 at 1:00 a.m.), and it is also running on MBS , BS NTV , and AT-X . HIDIVE is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

The anime's first season debuted on television on January 9 at 25:05 (effectively January 10 at 1:05 a.m.), before airing later that night on MBS . The anime then aired on BS NTV on January 11 at 12:00 a.m.). The anime debuted on ABEMA and d Anime Store on January 9 at 25:35 (effectively January 10 at 1:35 a.m.). The anime then debuted streaming on U-NEXT and Anime Hōdai on January 12. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Hamuo launched the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2019, and the story is ongoing. Earth Star Entertainment began publishing the series in print in July 2020.

Tetta launched the ongoing manga on Comic Earth Star in October 2020.

title: Dentsu Enters Partnership with Kodansha
content:
Variety reported on Friday that major Japanese advertising firm Dentsu is entering a partnership with Kodansha Ltd. that will give potential clients in North and South America access to several Kodansha intellectual properties (IPs) including Attack on Titan , Ghost in the Shell , and Blue Lock . The partnership makes Dentsu the central point of contact for brand marketers looking for sponsorships, tie-in campaigns, live events, and fan experiences related to the IPs.

Kodansha 's popular manga titles include Attack on Titan , Akira, Blue Lock , Cells at Work! , Tokyo Revengers , Initial D , and That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (which itself adapts a light novel series).

Kodansha announced in November 2025 that it had established Kodansha Studios in Hollywood with award-winning Chinese director Chloé Zhao ( Nomadland ) and film producer Nicolas Gonda. The company won a lawsuit against American internet infrastructure company Cloudflare in the same month that it had filed along with several other Japanese publishing companies. The company launched its manga distribution service K manga in May 2023.

Dentsu was founded in 1901 in Tokyo. The company is now active in 120 countries and territories. It established a new company called Dentsu Anime Solutions in July 2023. title: Scotland Loves Anime 2026 Details "Coming Soon"
content:
The Scotland Loves Anime festival has posted the following message on its X/Twitter feed:

"We know you're chomping at the bit to get your hands on the line-up for this year's festival, so this is just a quick update to shyly say it's coming very soon - we're finalising details to launch everything over the next couple of weeks. Stay tuned!"

Scotland Loves Anime had previously announced in February that the event would return in 2026, running at the Glasgow Film Theatre in November 6 to 8, and then at the Edinburgh Filmhouse from November 16 to 22. According to the February announcement, the festival would also come to London, with the date and venue details TBC. The same dates and venues are given on the lovesanimation.com website as of writing.

The festival began in 2010, running annually until 2019. During the Covid pandemic, there was an online festival in 2021, and the festival returned in full in 2022. 2024 was the first year in which the festival had a run in London.

The most recent festival was from October to November 2025, including screenings of All You Need Is Kill , Lupin the IIIrd: The Immortal Bloodline , ChaO , The Last Blossom and 100 Meters . Guests at the event included Takeshi Koike (the director of Redline and Lupin the IIIrd: The Immortal Bloodline ), Kenichiro Akimoto (the director of All You Need Is Kill ) and Yasuhiro Aoki (the director of ChaO ).

Source : Scotland Loves Anime X/Twitter feed
